propositions: The completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts on identical inputs: the same ticket, code, and criteria yield PASS on one run and FAIL (2-N unmet) minutes later with no intervening changes.

The verifier's test-existence judgments are unreliable due to unpredictable free-form search strategies; it falsely marks criteria unmet claiming no test exists when tests are present and discoverable (ad9f, 4de6 regressions).
The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar does not record verified_at_sha or trace_id, making it impossible to distinguish flaky non-determinism from input drift when comparing stored records.
Temperature and sampling settings are not pinned, allowing per-run variance to flip borderline criteria judgments between upheld and unmet.

The verifier's agent prompt lacks guidance that search_files uses literal case-sensitive substring matching (not regex/glob), leading to failed semantic queries that incorrectly conclude test absence.
